I think I figured it out. It was an issue of what I was launching the command from.

Firstly I was unintentionally running it from a git bash terminal and it did not seem to like that and had a permission issue.

Then I tried it in powershell and it did not like perl (I have strawberry perl installed for other work and it could not seem to find it)

Then I ran it in plain old cmd and it all worked fine... not sure the reason but that was the fix.
